description: This file is an Android Java source code for a Wear OS application activity named StandaloneMainActivity. It demonstrates creating and handling various styles of notifications on wearable devices, including BigTextStyle, BigPictureStyle, InboxStyle, and MessagingStyle. The class manages notification generation, user interaction, and adapts to different Android versions for notification behavior.

classes.name: StandaloneMainActivity
classes.description: An Android Wear OS activity that demonstrates creating and managing various styled notifications, handling user interactions with notifications, and implementing notification styles compatible across different Android versions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the RecyclerView and notification manager, and prepares the UI.

methods.name: itemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection from the RecyclerView to generate specific notification styles.

methods.name: generateBigTextStyleNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a BigTextStyle notification with actions.

methods.name: generateBigPictureStyleNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a BigPictureStyle notification with inline reply support.

methods.name: generateInboxStyleNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays an inbox-style notification with email summaries.

methods.name: generateMessagingStyleNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a messaging-style notification with support for wearables.

methods.name: openNotificationSettingsForApp
methods.description: Opens the app's notification settings screen for user to enable notifications.
